title: How to Get Your First Service Clients Paying Tens of Thousands

acquisition_channels.details: Used Angie's List and HomeAdvisor initially; recommends Thumbtack, TaskRabbit, Angie, and Google LSA for leads.
Recommends daily posts on Facebook and Instagram, an email newsletter, and social content aimed at adjacent trades.
Reports Instagram-driven referrals from other trades, including landscapers and roofers.
Builds relationships with material suppliers and adjacent trades who can refer deck projects.
Recommends meeting lumber yards and product sales representatives to introduce the company.
Reports a couple of Yelp promotions and says PPC, Google LSA, and Meta ads are planned.

ideas.delivery: The company quotes and manages deck projects, sources materials, and installs decks through its team and, where suitable, subcontractors.
